sekiro but cat. good game very satisfying

came to this game for the Sekiro-like combat. And oh my f*cking god! This game had WAAAY more to offer! Combat might look similar to Sekiro (in 2D), but devs took a different approach to the parry system, which works insanely well and feels really satisfying! (especially in boss fights)

- Narrative/Story - ABSOLUTE CINEMA!
- Main character - Arthur Morgan in cat body
- Audio design - eargasmic!
- Art style in Taopunk setting is stunning!

Beautiful game in every aspect

One of and if not the best games I've ever played. The combat system is really good and probably the best 2d/metroidvania combat systems I've seen. The story is great and emotional with amazing boss fights and soundtracks. Also it took about 20 or so hours for my first standard playthrough, which is unfortunately quite short, but the amount of quality makes up for it. 100% the game isn't hard either, so it was nice going around and finishing up the exploration before doing the "true ending".

(I don't know why it says I have 60 hours of playtime when in the save file inside the game says I have 24, I might've let the game run while I was at school or it didn't close properly)

The only criticisms I have is that some of the achievements can be soft-locked, so you have to play the entirety of the game again to get said achievements. (which is fine but since its a "play one time" type of game its kind of annoying) And I was slightly disappointed at the final boss, even though it was still a amazing fight, it lacked the difficulty I was seeking. (which might just be a me issue since I've seen other people struggle with them a lot)

Amazing game 10/10

Fantastic gameplay, story, and world with just the right amount of content. If you enjoy metroidvanias, this game is for you. If not for a handful of flaws and an unfortunate boss design. I'd say this game is pretty much perfect.

To be more specific about the 'flaws', there are a few bugs, small QoL things, a particular story choice forced loss with no story explanation why you had to lose . The biggest flaw is a certain boss with visually inaccurate hitboxes (It's a like they wanted a more difficult fight, but didn't update the animations). It turns the fight into relying on trial and error, and made me write a review to remind myself of the fun I had with the rest of the game. Although, once you do win, it's very rewarding.

Anyway, I'd like a sequel. Lol.

Criminally underrated, this game should be up for discussion as game of the year.

The content present is well thought out and it contains no BS filler. The art style is highly detailed whether an area is bright and vivid or dark and gloomy. Between the skill and thought required to progress through the game it will keep you on your toes and demand that you desire to get better and persevere.

Parrying in this game is almost as satisfying as it is in Sekiro. Similarly, it is a must learn mechanic from the start.

Nine Sols is not for those with fragile egos. If you desire a challenge pick this one up.

Nine Sols is a beautifully drawn metroidvania that takes you on an incredible journey across a unique world, inspired by Taoism and cyberpunk aesthetic. Fantastic blend of metroidvania, platforming, Sekiro-style parry combat, and stealth. The game has a beautiful story, soundtrack, and world. Immediately earns a place in the pantheon of new metroidvanias alongside Hollow Knight, Ori and the Blind Forest, and Blasphemous.

Easily one of the best metroidvania titles I've ever had the pleasure of playing. It's brutally hard, but it's beautiful. The story is wonderful, the music is absolutely enchanting, the art is phenomenal... I would even call this one of the top 10 best games I've ever played. If you like Hollow Knight, you'll -adore- this game.

This game is proof that we are living in the best timeline. If you like soulslikes and/or metroidvanias, or you are a human being attached to a brain and a heart, you owe it to yourself to try this out. The only quandry I have is the amount of dialogue. It's there to tell quite a compelling story but it is a lot to get through.

PS. It runs pretty smoothly for the most part but there is a late game enemy ( those pink slugs that hang from the ceiling and what not that can block certain pathways ) that made my framerate take an insane nose dive. I haven't seen anything like it, I would be playing in slow-mo until I killed them.

PSS. A boss rush mode would be very much welcome.

Nine Sols is a wonderful game that has left me in awe. Wherever it comes to the art, gameplay or soundtrack, everything is of amazing quality. The hand drawn art and traditional chinese aesthetic makes the game breathtaking. The soundtrack pairs very well with the ambience designed for each area. The combat is very precise leaving no room for mistakes. This is perfect if you are wishing for a tedious playtrought. Exploring is very fun, the unlockable abilities open loads of new path each more treacherous than the last. I would highly recommend this work of art.

Nine Sols is one of the best metroidvanias I've played. The artwork is great, the music/sound design is great, the exploration is great, the combat is excellent, the bossfights are awesome, and it's all brought together thematically to tell a compelling and satisfying story. I got the 100% and "good" ending on my first run, which took around 30 hrs. I died *a LOT*. I had to do a second run for the "bad" ending and miscellaneous *bad choices*, and have done a third run just for fun. I still pull up the boss rush every once and a while to replay the final boss; contender for best boss of all time.

Play this game, though you are warned: this game does not pull its punches.
Just buy it. If you like Hollow Knight, SilkSong, ULTRAKILL, or any other Indie game Buy This Game.

Incredible game. Combat feels super satisfying. Bosses are all cool. Story and the way is told are great. 
Massive streetcred to the ones that manage to beat this game's true ending. You are a true gamer.

Nine Souls is one of the best metroidvania style games I have played. From research the two others that I keep hearing are better are Blasphemous and Hollow Knight. I have not finished either but for me the art style and music in this game hit all the right notes. Nine Souls has an interesting story that unfolds over the course of about 20 hours. Along the way there are beautiful cutscenes, stunning comic strips for visual story telling, and great character development, all of which add to the fantastic boss fights. Due to the parry system the boss fights start to feel like a dance. The first couple deaths in a fight are just the moments of you learning beautiful choreography. Once the player becomes proficient enough in a fight, it just clicks. You begin understanding the combos predicting the next attacks and finding the small windows for massive damage. If you are a fan of the genre or looking to find a game to introduce yourself to the genre I can't recommend Nine Souls enough!

Cannot recommend playing this through to the true ending, never would have I thought that the story was going to pull on your heartstrings back to back to back. Very emotional finish to a very challenging game.

Good Game with a wonderful parry mechanic, good combat and good movement.
Can recommend it to everyone who enjoys Metroidvanias and Souls-Likes.

beautiful game with satisfying combat and parry system.
Hard Bosses with intimidating movesets and challenging patterns.
coming from me who played Sekiro and Lies of P, i definitely recommend this game.

best Indie game of 2024 for me.

music, gameplay, story, art style are all fantastic

probably one of the best metroidvanias out there

Incredible game. lots of love went into making this. be warned tho, the final boss has one of the biggest difficulty spikes i have ever experienced in a game, and as a veteran from software/soulslikes player i have conquered many challenges. if you love sekiro and hollow knight this game is a match made in heaven

This is genuinely one of my favourite games that I've ever played. The stunning hand-drawn artwork and dark futuristic setting initially captivated me to try it out, but I was quickly impressed by the lore-rich story that ended up tugging at all of my heart strings. I adored the MC and cast of supporting characters, unravelling secrets behind this taopunk dystopia, and the philosophical and moral discussions that you experience. The combat is challenging and engaging, but doable with the various skills that you unlock throughout the game. I highly recommend supporting the developers and trying out this game.

Incroyable Metroid-like dans un univers hyper original avec des personnages, un lore et une histoire superbes. 
C'est par défaut assez difficile (voire très très difficile) mais le "mode histoire" permet de doser tout ça à sa convenance sans ruiner l'expérience. (Même en mode histoire on rencontre du challenge). 

Pépite.

I have no idea how to place this game.

Excellent story revealed slowly that had me gripped throughout. Nail-biting gameplay that had me up multiple nights trying to do pattern recognition and speed up reaction time.

Watching this little dude do ninja hand signs to control sci fi technology sounds dumb but was the coolest thing I've seen in awhile.

But I can't recommend this game to most people. If you have difficulty parrying, go story mode. It's rough but especially the last boss. If you found parrying in sekiro fun, I cannot recommend this game enough.

Amazing game. Challenging but fair. There were no stupid gimmicks or deceptive delayed attacks. Every enemy attack is telegraphed with plenty of time for reaction. I liked the way player mechanics are introduced giving some time to prepare to what's coming in the next boss fight. Also I liked a detour from traditional metroidvania games when in comes to the map exploration. No hidden walls and very few secrets that can be easily missed.

The bosses are straight up unfair, every time I try to kill them their music starts to pop off and I start instinctively breakdancing in my room. Awful balancing and a fundamentally broken game. 1 0/10.

Nine Sols features some of the most fluid and well executed combat I have ever seen in a game, and is possibly the best metroidvania I've played. Everything in nine sols feels well done; the story was interesting and never felt like it hindered gameplay; upgrades felt well paced and were introduced clearly; and the bosses were easily the highlight of the game.

The diversity of builds was also very interesting to see, mainly when looking at other people play the game and seeing just how differently they played the game to me, which is a testament to how well made the combat is, as well as being remarkably fun to play; despite the game being incredibly difficult at points I rarely found myself frustrated.

I would easily recommend Nine Sols, it's one of the best games I have played, it does so many things remarkably well and has little to no flaws.

I first saw this game maybe 6 months before it released, both the art style and the ambition of making a sekiro-like metroidvania seemed too good to be true, but trust me they got it perfected. This game is difficult but like sekiro when you understand the combat it becomes one of the greatest combat systems to date. Genuinely one of the best metroidvanias to ever exist, definitely stands beside hollow knight at the peak of 2D gaming. 10/10

Ever since I played games like Hollow Knight and Sekiro, I'd been looking for a game that could fill that void; Nine Sols is basically like their love child. The combat is fantastic, every single boss in the game I had a moment where everything clicked into place and I would enter a flow state and end up defeating them. The final boss is one of the hardest I have ever had a chance to fight. The art, music and story are quite beautiful. The storytelling is well paced. Must play.

linear gameplay, not really a metroidvania so don't expect to like it because it is a metroidvania, very basic moveset, not fun at all in combat, all bosses are kinda the same, cool story but doesn't make up for the gameplay.

(I completed this game on the Switch for reasons)

If you like Hollow Knight, this is for you, and vise versa

Fantastic game. Exploration and traversal can be a little stale at times but it more than makes up for it with its top-tier world building, overall presentation, and combat.
The final boss is one of the best I've ever played; props to the developers for having the balls to make the last fight in the game a tough one.
very challenging boss fights with an incredible story, game play and sound track. must play souls-like imop
This goes under the radar for so many people. What an experience. Absolutely amazing game!

10/10. The artwork, the animation, the scoring, gameplay, and storywriting all top tier. I would even say that this is among the top 5 games I've ever played. I went in knowing absolutely nothing about this game and found myself completely stunned by what a masterpiece it was. 

First off, the art style is extremely beautiful and has its own unique charm. Add to that the beautiful scoring, which is better than alot of movies I've seen, and you have yourself being drawn in within the first 10 minutes of the game. 

The controls are also pretty damn slick. Edge grabbing does not suck, which makes traversing the world feel smooth. While parry windows and enemy hit boxes are a little tricky, it's never impossible and the fights feel difficult only due to my own lack of skill/practice rather than the controls or game mechanics holding me back. 

And finally, the story. I was gushing about the artwork and scoring before, but the story writing really takes the cake for the whole game. It's such an emotional journey with every single boss, some hitting harder than others. Each of the bosses has their own unique backstory which just keeps building and building until the final boss, where you finally see the entire picture and realize what kind of world the main character has created and lives in.
Great game for learning to parry! I enjoyed the story and it had a great balance of difficulty.

Sekrio + Hollow Knight. Two of my favorite games of all time are combined to make an absolute masterpiece. Highly recommended.

PS: THAT FINAL BOSS FIGHT WAS LITERAL PERFECTION OH MY GOD!

A new champion of the Metroidvania genre, Nine Sols is a refreshing breath of lore, theme & art style, and an introduction to new game-play mechanics in an already familiar engine. If you'll enjoy an Asian, Sci-Fi fantasy spin on the formula of Hollow Knight & other Soul-like classics then you've found a true gem.

Nine Sols is a game that I bought for the sake of interest, I haven't played metroidvania games for a long time, and the last and all recommended metroidvania which I played ( Hollow Knight ) caused me mixed emotions during the playthrough. So I didn't have high hopes for Nine Sols...

My surprise was unparalleled - I enjoyed the visual style, music, plot, characters, locations and enemies as well as bosses. 
The Gameplay , as it says on the Steam page, was inspired by Sekiro. The game is very dynamic and based on parrying (or reflecting), but the game is also friendly to newcomers and does not have too many requirements at the beginning of the game, the player learns new mechanics and gradually, without noticing it, gets better. Yes, you have to die a lot, but death is not a loss of progress, it's a lesson that is quickly learned.
The plot is enjoyable and doesn't prevent you from enjoying the game in the slightest with the well-crafted dialogues 
The Visual Style is beautiful and memorable, as is the music .
The Locations are varied and always have different “primary colors” and it is a pleasure to explore them. And the enemies on them improves that exploration experience.
The Bosses ( Sols ) are very memorable with both their character, story, design and how they fight.

In short, Nine Sols is a game that MUST be played. And preferably without spoilers.

I have fallen in love with this game within the first few hours of playing it

The visual style and soundtrack are both amazing.
The gameplay is compelling and keeps evolving (especially combat) making this title a blast to play through.
The parry mechanic is front and center of the game and it really is amazing to learn all the different strategies and tactics this game offers you, allowing you to find your own combat style.
The story is also very interesting and fun to follow.

Being a souls-like, it can sometimes be pretty hard or annoying, but I still highly recommend it to metroidvania or soulslike fans.

Genuinely incredible game. The soundtrack and art is beautiful, the story and characters are hooking and made me not want to put the game down, and the combat is incredibly challenging while managing to never feel unfair. Absolutely worth playing blind.

amazing game, if your looking for a true metroidvania id go play hollow knight or something else like it because nine sols ios heavy focused on combat and story and atleast to me the game has felt alot more guided than other metroidvanias and when you get around 10 hours in backtracking is almost nonexistent after u get teleportation. combat is genuinly undefeated tho some of my favorite combat ever in a game not just 2d or metroidvania its so satisfying. if your looking for a good story driven game with amazing combat and still feels like a metroidvania this will be a game you love.
this game is PEAK, 100% worth it. beautiful art style, satisfying combat, and unexpectedly good lore. if you loved hollow knight like i did then you will love this game too
Amazing game, great art and story, was a bit hard for some bosses but just skill issue ig

In general, very good attempt on metroivdvania genre. I would like to give a positive review and finish the game, but stealth section of the game gave me enough quit moments after an hour to just drop a game.

Nine sols is a story rich game with many emotional characters. The atmosphere of the game is very fascinating and exotic for me. The combat mechanics are a bit punishing like sometimes we loss all of our game currency when dying another time without collecting the corpse. The final boss is just insane, in my opinion, the quality of the final boss as well as others are almost 10/10 . Apart from these, the platforming is diversity with various of solutions.
Its like hollow knight except you get a reverse squirt of dopamine every time you parry something for 0.00000001 seconds to early. 10/10.
A good game with an absurd difficulty spike for the final boss that retroactively soured my opinion of the rest of the game.

Best metroidvania in years! Very challenging, but rewarding combat. 

Map kinda sux, you can't mark anything or check on quests. But you are not here for exploration, you are here to slain and murder in style!
This game absolutely rules, the *PANG* of the parry is so good, getting your ass whooped over and over before clawing back and overcoming a tough boss is insanely satisfying.

tldr.text: Overwhelmingly Positive (96%): most reviews praise the combat and the story.
The main complaint is the combat, which some players find tedious, with controls that feel inconsistent.

details.text: Recent reviews complain about the combat and story less often than all-time reviews do, though one says "this just isn’t what I’m looking for".
Players who reviewed after very little play are far less positive than long-time players, at 73% against 99%.
